title: Vybe
tagline: Vybe is a decentralized prediction platform that lets users forecast trends in the music industry.
description: Vybe is a decentralized social prediction platform where users forecast moments in culture like music drops, viral trends and creator milestones using transparent on-chain markets and verifiable off-chain data. By turning streaming data and cultural momentum into transparent on-chain markets, Vybe lets anyone participate in predicting which songs will go viral, which artists will grow fastest, or which genres will dominate next. Each prediction reflects real-world beliefs, powered by verifiable data from platforms like Spotify. Vybe bridges the gap between fandom and finance, transforming music discovery into a social, data driven and community owned experience. Predictions feel social: each market is posted like a feed update that users can like, comment on, and share. Users build their prediction identity through wins, reputation, and accuracy.
how_its_made:
Participants can connect any wallet such as MetaMask or Coinbase and join seamlessly regardless of which crypto asset or chain they use. Through Avail Nexus, Vybe facilitates cross-chain transactions and liquidity routing. Users digital assets are automatically converted into PYUSD on Base L2, which they can then stake to predict measurable outcomes like stream counts, viral trends, and artist growth Outcomes are verified via Spotify’s API, ensuring transparent and verifiable market resolutions. Vybe uses Envio for real-time indexing and analytics. Each market is transparently resolved using data fetched from verified APIs.  
Smart contracts written in Solidity manage market creation, trading (YES/NO AMM shares), and PYUSD payouts through a modular system:
PredictionMarketFactory: deploys market templates
BinaryMarket:  handles liquidity for YES/NO shares
OracleBridge:  posts verified results
SettlementManager: automates payouts
Off-chain infrastructure includes:
Envio for real-time indexing of markets, and creating a dashboard metrics for users
Avail Nexus SDK for cross-chain transactions
Node.js backend with Next.js + Tailwind frontend for live market feeds and social engagement
Arweave/IPFS to store hashed oracle responses and API proof data
Oracle verification follows a multi-source, multi-mode framework, APIs from Spotify and UMA-style optimistic oracles.
